# awesome Grok Bot

> An independent curated directory of Grok Bot shares, skills, MCP connectors, and guides.

All seed entries are listed, not workflow-tested. HTTP reachability is not an endorsement.
Metadata license is per entry; linked resources retain their own licenses.
